prompt_output_contract.company_input_rule: 회사 입력은 실회사 ㈜루트랩의 등록 사실이며 origin은 company_brochure·homepage·user_interview·agent_proposal 중 하나다. status가 confirmed인 사실만 보유·수행·자격의 근거다. proposed(에이전트 제안값)와 unknown은 확인되지 않은 값이며 보유·미보유 어느 쪽 근거도 아니다.
prompt_output_contract.evidence_rule: Copy source_sha256, block_key, and exact quote from the supplied frozen units. Never invent evidence or company facts.
prompt_output_contract.input_rule: Use only the frozen batch, ontology, deterministic compare rows, role inputs, and synthesis input supplied for this call.
prompt_output_contract.repair_rule: A validation_repair request may repair JSON syntax or the fixed output schema only. Return a complete replacement for the identical frozen input without changing identifiers, evidence, facts, or meaning.
prompt_output_contract.unknown_rule: Preserve unknown and null. A missing fact, partial path, unmapped requirement, or unaccepted condition is not proof of absence or compliance.

stages.instruction: Extract the supplied batch into bidops.requirement-extract.v1. BidOps validates the answer deterministically and rejects the whole batch on any deviation, so follow this contract exactly. (1) Items: return exactly one item per input unit, in input order, with item.unit_id equal to that unit's unit_id; never split, merge, skip, or add units. Several conditions of one unit are several constraints of that one item. A unit whose text is only a title still yields one item whose normalized_requirement and evidence quote the title. (2) Concepts: each input unit carries expected_concepts, computed by code from exact ontology label/alias matches in that unit's text. The item's concept_candidates must equal that unit's expected_concepts: copy every {concept_id, alias_text} pair unchanged and add nothing else (an empty expected_concepts means an empty concept_candidates). Never map text to a concept by meaning, never use an ontology label or alias that is not in expected_concepts, and never use a null concept_id. (3) Quotes: every evidence quote, constraint quote, and alias_text is an exact substring of the text of the named block (same source_sha256 and block_key) of the same unit; copy characters verbatim, including spaces and symbols. (4) Constraints: value, unit, and operator are the quote's own expression, and a numeric constraint quotes the shortest exact substring that holds that single number (a quote with several different numbers is valid only with operator unknown). kind=date only when the quote writes the full date as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.M.D, or YYYY년 M월 D일, and its value is YYYY-MM-DD; a year, a month, or any other date expression is kind=text with a value copied verbatim from the quote. unit=person only for a count written as N명; any other count (servers, licenses, items) has unit=null. kind=amount only for 원, 천원, 백만원, or 억원 amounts, with the value in KRW. operator: 이상 or 최소 means gte; 이하, 이내, or 최대 means lte; a value without these words means eq; a quote with both directions, a range (N~N), alternatives (N/N), 초과, 미만, 약, 정도, 전후, 내외, or a relative date (착수 후, 계약 후) means unknown. fact_key is always null; BidOps links company facts deterministically. Never repeat an identical constraint, evidence, or concept pair within an item. (5) Every number in normalized_requirement occurs in the unit text. Represent uncertain values as unknown; never invent requirements, numbers, or evidence.
Assess eligibility and economics from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition.
Assess technical fit from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition.
Assess operations risk from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition.

Synthesize the three validated role outputs into bidops.practitioner-verdict.v1. Preserve conflicts and unknowns; do not produce a bid Go/No-Go decision. The input missing_sections lists the source areas the selector did not find in the notice; their requirements are unknown. While missing_sections is non-empty the verdict must not be "진행 가능" (the highest allowed verdict is "조건부 진행").
